 WTT: Reconstructing Private Equity: Portfolio Construction for the Post-Distribution Drought Jul 24, 2025

 The movies from my teenage years foreshadowed
the topsy-turvy world of today’s private equity industry. Back
then, we heard of  strange things afoot at the Circle
K  (Bill & Ted’s Excellent Adventure)
and  dogs and cats living
together  (Ghostbusters). Today, a lack of
distributions and secondary sales from longstanding leaders strange
things in the industry and the convergence of public and private
assets might feel like dogs and cats living together.

  

 I’ve been thinking about how this will play
out over time and in particular, where future commitments from LPs
will land.

 Read Ted’s blog  here .

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
